scope: Fresh focused renders from isolated GP12 reviewed index plus separately reviewed GP13 patch; all four rendered PNGs visually inspected after targeted Guild regeneration.

visual_review.dorm-stair-before.png: Missing final tread leaves the visible upper turn detached from the deck edge.
visual_review.dorm-stair-after.png: Restored oak tread visibly connects the surviving upper turn to the bedroom landing; post and lower flight preserved.
visual_review.dorm-room-cutaway-before.png: Shows the broken stair in the context of the existing upper deck and three bunks.
visual_review.dorm-room-cutaway-after.png: The one restored top tread appears at the landing; bunks, deck, rugs and room envelope are unchanged.

render_limits: Offline straight native stairs are two geometric boxes; slabs and carpets use reduced thickness, while furniture and colors remain approximations. No native Bedrock texture, light, collision, steering or pathfinding execution.
